name: pdk-native-db-rust
instr:
Please finish selected drains in native_db at `/app`, with reusable windows and fallible row filters so callers can remove a batch without losing the rest. Don't add new crates.

In `native_db::transaction::query` (paths below omit the crate name), add:
- `transaction::query::RwDrain::primary_range<T: ToInput, R: RangeBounds<impl ToKey>>(&self, range: R) -> Result<Vec<T>>`
- `transaction::query::RwDrain::primary_start_with<T: ToInput>(&self, prefix: impl ToKey) -> Result<Vec<T>>`
- Replace the placeholder with `transaction::query::RwDrain::secondary<T: ToInput>(&self, key_def: impl ToKeyDefinition<KeyOptions>) -> Result<SecondaryDrain<'db, 'txn, T>>`.

Expose `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain<'db, 'txn, T: ToInput>` with methods `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain::all(&self) -> Result<Vec<T>>`, `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain::range<R: RangeBounds<impl ToKey>>(&self, range: R) -> Result<Vec<T>>`, `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain::start_with(&self, prefix: impl ToKey) -> Result<Vec<T>>`, and `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain::equal(&self, key: impl ToKey) -> Result<Vec<T>>`. Use the existing `db_type` traits and `Result`.

Both handles have `window(&self, offset: usize, limit: Option<usize>, reverse: bool) -> Self`, at `transaction::query::RwDrain::window` and `transaction::query::SecondaryDrain::window`. A new handle defaults to `(0, None, false)`; `window` returns a handle with replacement settings. Secondary handles inherit their parent's settings. Each call use
